name: Ole Finchley
life: Ole learned to ask what driving actually buys a patient. For this cabdriver it bought the pleasure of knowing a route better than the passenger. Choosing a journey is one part of that pleasure he can keep. Wednesday often includes a stop at Maré Coffee, where Ole likes the table where people coming off shift stop checking the time.
voice: I watched him do everything right until two things happened together. He asked me to explain that to his grandson without using the word failing. We're making a map of journeys he can still choose.
appearance: Out of work clothes, look for a cropped bottle-green coat and a small enamel bird on the lapel. Ole has full cheeks and a mouth that pulls slightly to one side, with a high puff tied with plain cord. Ole presses the lips together to keep a smile in during a conversation.
personality: Ole can be lavish with time and quite careful with cash. A free afternoon is sometimes the biggest gift Ole can afford to give, and family knows to take it seriously.
agenda: To draw a useful travel map with the family.
family: Desmond Baldwin is Ole’s half-sibling. Ole chooses an ordinary story to tell. Desmond asks the question the rest of the family avoided. They tend to get further with an important subject when it arrives in the middle of talk about dinner or work. Asked about *Salt in the pockets*, Desmond says, “I fix linings. Someone had stitched a tiny silk fish beneath the salt line.”
connections: Tait Wynn. They propose letting the former driver teach one lesson about what a license can and can't measure.

reactions.situation: The old driver wants to change the farewell route
reactions.response: Ole takes the changed route seriously and checks who needs to know the new return time.

reactions.situation: An argument on the pavement makes a bystander feel unsafe
reactions.response: Ole walks with the bystander to a staffed doorway and checks whether they want someone called.

reactions.situation: If invited to an expensive outing
reactions.response: Ole suggests meeting afterward and explains why without asking the others to abandon their plans.
